top_stories.title: OpenAI: Research Acceleration and the Jagged Frontier
top_stories.summary: OpenAI has published new findings on how AI is accelerating scientific research, examining where AI assistance delivers clear gains and where its performance remains uneven — the so-called 'jagged frontier'. The post explores implications for research workflows and productivity across disciplines.

top_stories.title: "Anthropic Is Not a Safe AI Company" — Coalition Challenges Safety Branding Ahead of IPO
top_stories.summary: A broad coalition of scientists, legal scholars, and technology leaders has filed a public challenge against Anthropic's positioning as a safety-focused AI company, timing the statement ahead of the company's anticipated IPO. The group argues that Anthropic's practices do not live up to its stated safety commitments.

top_stories.title: Microsoft AI Announces Seven New World-Class Models at Scalable Price-Performance
top_stories.summary: At Microsoft Ignite 2026, Microsoft AI unveiled seven new models designed to offer improved price-performance trade-offs across a range of enterprise use cases. The announcement signals Microsoft's continued push to broaden access to capable AI models at different cost tiers.

top_stories.title: OpenAI: Inside the Codex Sandbox
top_stories.summary: OpenAI has published a detailed look inside the Codex sandbox environment, explaining how the AI coding system is tested and constrained during development. The post offers transparency into how OpenAI evaluates and limits Codex's capabilities before deployment.

top_stories.title: Can Peer Review Survive AI-Generated Text? [pdf]
top_stories.summary: A new academic paper from the University of Pennsylvania examines the growing challenge AI-generated text poses to the integrity of peer review in academic publishing. The authors assess current detection methods and propose frameworks for maintaining research quality.

further_links.title: Google DeepMind Introduces Gemini 4 Neon
further_links.summary: Google DeepMind has announced Gemini 4 Neon, a new addition to its Gemini model family, via an official blog post.

further_links.title: Google DeepMind: Genie 4 Is Now Available
further_links.summary: DeepMind has made Genie 4 available, its interactive world-generation model, marking a significant step in AI-generated interactive environments.

further_links.title: How Meta Uses AI Agents to Scale ML Innovations Across Ads Ranking Models
further_links.summary: Meta's engineering blog details how the company deploys AI agents to automate and accelerate improvements to its advertising ranking machine learning models at scale.

further_links.title: OpenAI: The Silent Consensus
further_links.summary: OpenAI has published a piece titled 'The Silent Consensus', exploring themes around AI's influence on opinion and discourse.

further_links.title: Black High School Students Sue After AI Mistakes Doritos Bag for Gun
further_links.summary: The Lawyers' Committee for Civil Rights Under Law has filed a lawsuit on behalf of Black students who were detained and searched after an AI security system falsely identified a bag of chips as a firearm, raising concerns about AI bias in school safety settings.

further_links.title: The AI Hype Index: AI Is Everywhere
further_links.summary: MIT Technology Review's AI Hype Index takes stock of the current state of AI proliferation across industries, assessing what is real progress versus inflated expectations. [Metered]

further_links.title: AI Agents Ask Better Questions Than KPMG Accountants in Audit Trial
further_links.summary: A reported audit trial found that AI agents outperformed KPMG accountants in formulating questions during the audit process, suggesting significant potential for AI in professional services.

further_links.title: How Sumitomo Life's Leaders Helped Teams Adopt ChatGPT Enterprise
further_links.summary: OpenAI's customer story with Sumitomo Life details how the Japanese insurer's leadership drove organisation-wide adoption of ChatGPT Enterprise across its workforce.

further_links.title: Artex Is Criminals' New Favourite 'Point-and-Shoot' AI Hacking Tool
further_links.summary: Wired reports on Artex, a new AI-powered hacking tool being adopted by criminal groups for its ease of use, lowering the technical barrier to launching cyberattacks. [Metered]

further_links.title: AI Is Killing All About Berlin
further_links.summary: A blogger documents how AI-generated content is flooding search results and undercutting traffic to his long-running expat guide site, All About Berlin, illustrating the broader impact of generative AI on independent web publishers.
